sample.rule: Per original scenario take chronological first, middle floor((n-1)/2), last eligible completion, plus all pre-completion incumbent_rho>=1 states. Uses no new value labels.
sample.pilot_rule: Known selected GRID95 cases may enter training when their calendar date is in training; exclude from headline evaluation and list separately. No synthetic duplication.

intervention: Original controller/model/order/128/64/2/0.9 unchanged; omit completion exactly once, then original FRAME continuation. Fresh full prefixes reconstruct memory. No observation-only reset.

horizon.primary: scheduled original episode end, not factual early-failure time

label.rule: External attack mismatch => unresolved. Identical entire physical path with no more total forecast queries => SKIP equivalent-path (even if both inherit the same factual early failure). Otherwise complete-vs-fail favors the completing branch. Both fail with different paths => unresolved. Both complete => Pareto comparison of operational cost, all forecast queries, overload steps, max rho and overload-excess sum. One branch no worse in every component and strictly better in at least one => its label; otherwise MIXED.
label.limitations: Numeric tolerances are inherited diagnostic reporting tolerances, not safety guarantees or fitted practical-equivalence margins. Label scope original continuation and fixed sampled future, not a learned gated closed loop.

learning.weighting: Equal total weight per training calendar date, normalized to mean1; no class oversampling.
learning.preprocessing: Logistic training-fold weighted mean/std only, constant columns scale1; forest uses raw inputs.
validation: leave calendar date out; G1/G2 same dates withheld together
learning.unknown_labels: Retain and report but exclude from fitting/scoring; missing training classes use explicitly padded probabilities; constant classifier if one class only.
learning.decision: Predict multiclass preferences; proposed omission only when P(SKIP)>=0.95 and SKIP is argmax. Also report fixed0.5, no threshold selection.
metrics: missed KEEP separately from disputed MIXED
per-state raw value for proposed skips

timing: No efficiency benchmarking. Label collection first; no training until every physical child exits and saved-data audit passes.
forbidden: sum overlapping per-state gains into whole-policy savings
